UserStudyProgress.title: UserStudyProgress
UserStudyProgress.description: Tracks a student's preparation progress for a specific TG ECET CSE topic.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

notes.description: Personal revision notes for the topic.

bookmarkedResourceIds.description: Array of verified resource IDs bookmarked by the user.

UserStudyTask.title: UserStudyTask
UserStudyTask.description: Represents a study task linked to a topic and optionally synchronized to Google Tasks.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

topicId.description: Topic ID associated with this study task.

googleTaskId.description: Google Tasks task ID if synced.

completed.description: Whether the study task is marked as completed.

/users/{userId}/studyProgress/{topicId}.description: Collection of topic study progress records per user.

/users/{userId}/studyTasks/{taskId}.description: Collection of study tasks per user.
